description: 285A.T daily adjusted-close price series (JPY); per-stock slice of the prices blob.

body.how_to_read: Filter primary_id == '285A.T' in data/blobs/prices.csv; 'value' is the adjusted close in JPY, one row per trading day (TS).

methodology.summary: Per-stock slice of the prices pipeline output (prices.csv); 354 daily rows 2024-12-18..2026-06-05. Mechanically templated over the blob's distinct tickers (one card per stock). Confidence 0.9 (realized market prices).
